title: Why do the seals on a nitrogen-protected pit tempering furnace need cooling water?
summary: Cooling a seal and circulating hot gas around workpieces are different duties. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s nitrogen-protected pit tempering furnace proposal dated 14 September 2022 provides water cooling at the retort flange seal and water-cooled circulation-fan bearings. Confirm sealing, fan cooling and furnace atmosphere separately. Cooling water is not a workpiece-cooling system, and a nitrogen inlet does not establish verified protection.
